capabilities: detect newly web-clipped markdown files in monitored folders
download remote images in the background
rewrite image URLs to local references
bypass CDN hotlink protection using the page source URL as Referer
customize image save paths and filenames with templates
extras: Desktop only (depends on Node.js https module); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: When you use the Obsidian Web Clipper to save a webpage, images are not saved locally — they remain as remote URLs.
problem: Notes saved with the Obsidian Web Clipper keep images as remote URLs, so they can break or disappear instead of being stored in the vault.

relations.evidence: When you use the Obsidian Web Clipper to save a webpage, images are not saved locally

summary: Downloads remote images from web-clipped notes and replaces their URLs with local file references.
